nodes.label: PWA Icon 192x192
nodes.description: 192px downscale of the CouRageD logo on black; standard PWA manifest icon.

nodes.label: PWA Maskable Icon 512x512
nodes.description: 512px CouRageD logo shrunk inside a black safe-zone padding.
nodes.rationale: Extra padding keeps the mark inside the maskable safe zone so Android adaptive icon masks (circle/squircle) do not crop it.

nodes.label: PWA Icon 512x512
nodes.description: 512px full-bleed CouRageD logo; standard large PWA manifest icon / splash.

nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon
nodes.description: Small (~180px) CouRageD logo on black for iOS home-screen install.

nodes.label: CouRageD Brand Logo
nodes.description: Square master logo on black: gold/yellow illustrated muscular man and woman (woman holding a dumbbell, gym/fitness theme) above red brush-script 'CouRageD' wordmark with white outline.

nodes.label: PWA Install Icons
nodes.rationale: Icon set (192, 512, 512 maskable, apple-touch) required for installable PWA across Android, desktop and iOS.

nodes.label: Annual Membership
nodes.rationale: Yearly insurance tracked apart from gym time.

nodes.label: Export Sales
nodes.rationale: Uses price/cost at time of sale; voided sales listed separately and excluded; totals after discounts so they match Analytics.

nodes.label: Inventory
nodes.rationale: Stock only changes through receive/count/write-off actions, each logged in product History with who made it, for auditability.

nodes.label: Membership Plans
nodes.rationale: Plans/services have no stock so they live in Members > Plans, not Inventory. Length in days tracks per member; blank for walk-ins.

nodes.label: Payroll
nodes.rationale: SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and BIR withholding settled month-to-date with editable effective-dated rate tables (pre-filled 2025 rates, accountant to confirm).

nodes.label: PGlite
nodes.rationale: In-process Postgres to run schema and every patch and verify permissions as staff, admin and inactive users.

nodes.label: Profiles Role (admin/staff/inactive)
nodes.rationale: Public sign-up disabled; admins create accounts which start inactive until given a role. There is always at least one admin.

nodes.label: SheetJS
nodes.rationale: Installed from cdn.sheetjs.com, not npm; free edition can't write styles, so bold headers, yellow subtotal rows and frozen header are post-processed into the file.

nodes.label: Student/Senior/PWD Price
nodes.rationale: Charged on the register and recorded as a discount noted 'Student/Senior/PWD discount'.

nodes.label: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
nodes.rationale: Server-only secret; never prefixed VITE_ or committed, so it never ships to the browser. Used only by api/staff.js after an admin check.

nodes.label: CourageD POS
nodes.rationale: Separate app and Vercel project from the marketing site (../couraged), sharing brand tokens; staff-only register, inventory and analytics for CourageD Fitness Hub.

nodes.label: robots noindex, nofollow
nodes.rationale: Staff-only app, kept out of search engines.

nodes.label: Membership Renewal
nodes.rationale: Days are added after current end date, or from today if lapsed; voiding the sale takes them back off.

nodes.label: Numbered SQL Patches (001-013)
nodes.rationale: Run in order after schema.sql; each patch is idempotent (safe to run again).

nodes.label: Void With Reason
nodes.rationale: Records are never deleted; sales, expenses and pay runs are voided with a reason to keep an audit trail.
